name: Llubí (Spain)
description: The four red bars of Aragon on yellow, charged at the centre with the arms of Llubí (a lozenge bearing a castle with flags and a wolf on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Llubí; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Llubí arms — lozenge with a castle with flags and a wolf on yellow
